thread:
michelle: Hey team, short async design thread for Playground chat changes. Focus areas: streamed token rendering (visual + perf), stop / regenerate UX, compact token indicator vs detailed breakdown, and making the prompt shelf easier to find. Drop quick bullets not long essays.

rachel: TL;DR: prefer single growing response node with micro-flushes for punctuation so it feels "alive" but avoids many DOM nodes.

samir: Agree with Rachel. UX compromise: show interim punctuation flush ("..." or sentence end) rather than every token. Also add a small shimmer while the model calculates next chunk.

jia: Accessibility: streamed output must be in an aria-live region but updates must be debounced. Suggest batching updates every 300ms and only announce final sentence completion. Use role=status and aria-atomic=false for intermediate updates.

noah: Stop/regenerate: two separate affordances. Stop should be immediate and destructive (cancels request). Regenerate should be available after generation ends and must re-run pipeline identical to last prompt + system state. Place both in the right side of the response header.

michelle: Placement proposal: in the response card header show small icon buttons: [Stop ■] (visible during streaming), then after finish replace with [Regenerate ↻] and [Copy ⧉]. Keep labels hidden for compactness but visible on hover/focus.

samir: keyboard shortcuts: Esc to stop (while streaming), Alt+R to regenerate (to avoid Cmd/Ctrl+R). Also allow user to rebind shortcuts in settings later. Example snippet:
```
// shortcuts
Esc -> stopGeneration
Alt+R -> regenerate
/ -> openPromptShelf
```

jia: For screen readers, Esc shouldn't be hijacked globally; only when focus is inside the response area/composer. Document this in the a11y checklist. Also ensure focus order doesn't jump when the regenerate button appears.

rachel: Token indicator: make a compact inline pill bottom-right of the response card showing total tokens (e.g., "42 tokens"). Clicking expands a popover with breakdown (prompt / response / cached). Popover should include link "How tokens map to billing".

noah: On perf: updating token counts every token is expensive. Cache counts and emit updates at chunk flush or 500ms intervals. For streaming, show a live estimate with a ~±2 token accuracy note.

michelle: Copy change idea: label the popover header "Token usage (estimated)" during streaming, then remove estimate note on completion. Tooltip text: "Estimated token usage while generating. Final counts shown after generation."

rachel: Prompt shelf: propose a visible shelf toggle in the composer (left of send) with a stacked-squares icon and label "Prompts" on larger screens. On mobile use a bottom-sheet. Also suggest keyboard shortcut "/" to open quick-pick.

samir: Discoverability: add an in-product hint (only for new users) that points at the prompt shelf for first 3 sessions: "Try a starter prompt →" with a small chevron.

jia: Prompt shelf A11y: make it reachable via skip link: "Skip to prompts" and ensure listbox semantics for options. When preview pane shows sample convo, mark it aria-hidden unless explicitly focused.

noah: Data idea: add telemetry events for: streaming stop pressed, regenerate pressed, token-popover opened, prompt-shelf opened, prompt-inserted. We'll use this to measure feature usage and whether users prefer breakdown vs compact.

michelle: Edge cases: 1) If user scrolls up while streaming, don't auto-scroll; show a small sticky "Go to live" button. 2) If regenerate fails due to quota, show non-blocking toast and a fallback to last output. 3) Ensure pasted prompts carry metadata token estimates but not user PII.

ux-bot: reminder: design review meeting Fri 9am if anyone wants to go over mocks live :calendar:.

michelle: Action list: Samir - update Figma with streaming micro-flush + icon set (Wed EOD). Rachel - token pill + popover mocks (Wed). Jia - a11y checklist and snippet examples (Tue). Noah - telemetry event list + suggested names (Wed). I'll run 15m review after mocks. Thanks! :sparkles:

samir: ack
